process_area.title: Ethics Governance, Speak-Up Channel & Intake Operations

fields.Owner: Ethics & Compliance Officer / Chief Compliance Officer
fields.Participants: Ethics & Compliance Officer, CEO/Board Audit & Risk Committee (links to VS-36/VS-21), Legal (links to VS-100.3), HR (links to VS-19/VS-103), Internal Audit (links to VS-21), ABC/AML (links to VS-86), Loss Prevention (links to VS-23), Risk (links to VS-21.2), Cross-Entity (links to VS-72)
fields.Trigger: Annual governance planning (links to VS-36/VS-33.1); program review

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-report of "report volume, substantiation rate, cycle-time, retaliation incidents,…" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System continuous audit of "Ethics & Compliance Officer establish the governance" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-capture of "Board Audit & Risk Committee ratify the ethics strategy" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: board reporting line; operational: all-violation scope
Pain Points / Risks: - **Lack-of-independence risk**: Program reports through line management, suppressing reports; mitigated by board reporting line
- **Scope-narrowness risk**: Program covers only ABC, missing other misconduct; mitigated by all-violation scope
System Touchpoints: - Governance/board (links to VS-36); audit/risk (links to VS-21.2); legal (links to VS-100.3); HR (links to VS-19/VS-103); ABC/AML (links to VS-86); loss prevention (links to VS-23); cross-entity (links to VS-72)

steps.activity: Ethics & Compliance Officer define the ethics & integrity program strategy and governance: scope (all violation types — ABC/AML, fraud/theft, harassment/discrimination, safety/environmental, consumer-protection, antitrust, conflicts, vendor/supply-chain integrity), the framework (ISO 37001 ABMS / 37301 CMS aligned), the speak-up channel strategy (W3715), the operating model (independent of line/HR where needed), and KPIs (report volume, substantiation rate, cycle-time, retaliation incidents, culture-trust score)

Ethics & Compliance Officer establish the governance: Ethics & Compliance Officer authority and independence (reports to the board audit/risk committee per links to VS-36), the Ethics Committee (W3719), the cross-functional investigation model (HR, Legal, LP, ABC, Audit), and integration to ABC (VS-86), audit (VS-21), legal (VS-100), and risk (VS-21.2)

Board Audit & Risk Committee ratify the ethics strategy, policy, and authority, approve the program budget (links to VS-17.4), and set the integrity-objective; communicate the mandate enterprise-wide (links to W3718)
steps.r: Board Audit Committee / Ethics & Compliance Officer

fields.Participants: Ethics & Compliance Officer, Legal (links to VS-100.3), HR (links to VS-19/VS-103), ABC (links to VS-86.3), Risk (links to VS-21.2), Communications (links to VS-14.3/VS-103.2), Records (links to VS-88)
fields.Trigger: Policy cycle; regulatory change; case learning
fields.Volume: Code of Conduct and ethics policy suite

workflows.name: Code of Conduct, Ethics Policy & Standards Management

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-capture of "entertainment, fraud & asset-protection, harassment/discrimination/respect,…" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-communication of "communicate changes enterprise-wide" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-586 (ensure controlled execution — Ethics Governance, Speak-Up Channel & Intake Operations (PA-119.1).)
- operational: case-driven refresh; operational: attestation and training (W3718)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Policy-staleness risk**: Code not updated to reflect new risks/cases; mitigated by case-driven refresh
- **Awareness-gap risk**: Policy exists but workforce unaware; mitigated by attestation and training (W3718)
System Touchpoints: - Legal (links to VS-100.3); HR (links to VS-19/VS-103); ABC (links to VS-86.3); data privacy (links to VS-91); compliance (links to VS-22); records (links to VS-88); communications (links to VS-14.3/VS-103.2)

steps.activity: Ethics & Compliance Officer/Legal maintain the Code of Conduct and ethics policy suite: anti-bribery/corruption, conflicts of interest, gifts & entertainment, fraud & asset-protection, harassment/discrimination/respect, safety & environmental conduct, consumer/data protection, vendor integrity, and the speak-up/whistleblower policy with protection guarantees

Ethics & Compliance Officer manage policy alignment across the program: integrate to ABC policy (links to VS-86.3/W2943), HR conduct policy (links to VS-19), data-privacy (links to VS-91), consumer protection (links to VS-22), and the internal-controls matrix; manage policy versioning and publication (links to VS-88)

Ethics & Compliance Officer refresh policy from case learning (W3728) and regulatory change (links to VS-22.3), communicate changes enterprise-wide (links to W3718), and attest employee acknowledgment (links to VS-19.4 training/attestation)

fields.Participants: Ethics & Compliance Officer, Speak-Up Intake team, third-party hotline vendor (links to W3720), HR (links to VS-103.1), IT (links to VS-27), Legal (links to VS-100.3), Cross-Entity (links to VS-72)
fields.Volume: Report volume across the workforce (~6,762 + contingent + vendors)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "Ethics & Compliance Officer/Intake capture each report" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-route of "route to triage" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-586 (ensure controlled execution — Ethics Governance, Speak-Up Channel & Intake Operations (PA-119.1).)
- operational: anonymity (W3716) and independence; operational: multi-channel + language
Pain Points / Risks: - **Channel-trust risk**: Reporters distrust the channel (fear of exposure/retaliation); mitigated by anonymity (W3716) and independence
- **Accessibility-gap risk**: Channel not available in Filipino/after-hours to front-line staff; mitigated by multi-channel + language
System Touchpoints: - Case-management system (links to W3720); third-party hotline/intake vendor (links to W3720); HR case mgmt (links to VS-103.1); IT/security (links to VS-27.3); legal (links to VS-100.3); cross-entity (links to VS-72)

steps.activity: Ethics & Compliance Officer operate multi-channel intake: 24/7 third-party hotline (phone/SMS), web-portal, email, mobile-app form, and in-person to HR/Ethics/LP — available to employees, contractors, vendors, customers, and the public; ensure language accessibility (Filipino/English) and channel awareness (links to W3718)

Ethics & Compliance Officer/Intake capture each report: the allegation (who/what/when/where), category, evidence, reporter preference (named/anonymous/confidential), and risk/urgency; create the case record (links to W3717) with strict need-to-know access

Ethics & Compliance Officer acknowledge the report to the reporter (where possible) within SLA, confirm protection (W3716), and route to triage (W3717); manage intake quality and channel-performance with the vendor (links to W3720)

fields.Participants: Ethics & Compliance Officer, Legal (links to VS-100.3), HR (links to VS-19/VS-84), IT/Security (links to VS-27.3), LP (links to VS-23), Risk (links to VS-21.2), Board Audit Committee (links to VS-36)
fields.Trigger: Report intake (W3715); retaliation concern; protection need

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-assign of "Ethics & Compliance Officer/Legal maintain the whistleblower protection framework" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-report of "reporter identity where requested, audit trail, and data-protection" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-monitor of "monitor for retaliation" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-586 (ensure controlled execution — Ethics Governance, Speak-Up Channel & Intake Operations (PA-119.1).)
- operational: confidentiality controls; operational: anti-retaliation policy and monitoring (W3725)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Identity-exposure risk**: Reporter identity leaks, causing retaliation/suppression; mitigated by confidentiality controls
- **Retaliation risk**: Reporter punished for speaking up; mitigated by anti-retaliation policy and monitoring (W3725)
System Touchpoints: - Legal (links to VS-100.3); IT/security (links to VS-27.3); data privacy (links to VS-91); HR (links to VS-19/VS-84); risk (links to VS-21.2); governance (links to VS-36); retaliation monitoring (links to W3725)

steps.activity: Ethics & Compliance Officer/Legal maintain the whistleblower protection framework: anonymity option (where law/policy allows), strict confidentiality/need-to-know, anti-retaliation policy and guarantees, protection measures (interim reassignment, monitoring), and the legal basis (RA 11032 anti-red tape, SEC governance code, and contractual/ethical protection)

Ethics & Compliance Officer/IT ensure technical confidentiality: secure case-management access controls, anonymization of reporter identity where requested, audit trail, and data-protection (links to VS-91/VS-27.3) so reporter identity cannot be exposed

Ethics & Compliance Officer/HR/Legal monitor for retaliation (links to W3725) and act on any retaliation against a reporter/witness/investigator; report protection posture and retaliation incidents to the Ethics Committee (W3719) and board audit committee (links to VS-36)

fields.Participants: Ethics & Compliance Officer, Legal (links to VS-100.3), HR (links to VS-19/VS-103), ABC/AML (links to VS-86), LP (links to VS-23), Audit (links to VS-21), Risk (links to VS-21.2), IT/Security (links to VS-27.3)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-track of "track and the independent investigator" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-route of "route the case" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-notify of "notify the Ethics Committee of high-severity cases" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: conflict-recusal and independence; operational: triage SLA
Pain Points / Risks: - **Mis-routing risk**: Report routed to the accused's chain, suppressing it; mitigated by conflict-recusal and independence
- **Triage-delay risk**: Reports sit untriaged, delaying action on urgent matters; mitigated by triage SLA
System Touchpoints: - Case-management (links to W3720); ABC (links to VS-86/W2943); LP (links to VS-23); audit (links to VS-21); HR (links to VS-19/VS-84); HSE (links to VS-24); legal (links to VS-100.3); risk (links to VS-21.2)

steps.activity: Ethics & Compliance Officer triage each report: classify by violation type (ABC, fraud/theft, harassment/discrimination, safety/environmental, consumer/data, conflict, vendor-integrity, other), assess credibility, severity, urgency, and risk; determine the investigation track and the independent investigator

Ethics & Compliance Officer route the case: ABC → ABC track (links to W2943/VS-86) within the program; fraud/theft → LP/audit (links to VS-23/VS-21) with ethics oversight; harassment/HR-conduct → HR-investigation (links to VS-19/VS-84) with ethics oversight where independence needed; safety/environmental → HSE (links to VS-24); serious matters → Legal/Ethics-led (links to W3721)

Ethics & Compliance Officer manage conflicts of interest in routing (recuse where the accused is in the reporting chain), assign case ownership, set the investigation SLA, and open the case in case-management (links to W3720); notify the Ethics Committee of high-severity cases (links to W3719)

fields.Participants: Ethics & Compliance Officer, HR/L&D (links to VS-19.4/VS-103), Communications (links to VS-14.3/VS-103.2), Store Ops (links to VS-07), Legal (links to VS-100.3), ABC (links to VS-86.3)
fields.Trigger: Onboarding; annual cycle; case learning; policy change

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-report of "report, protection guarantees" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-post of "posters at 200 stores/DCs, digital channels" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "track awareness KPIs, and refresh content from case learning" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-586 (ensure controlled execution — Ethics Governance, Speak-Up Channel & Intake Operations (PA-119.1).)
- operational: visible promotion at store level; operational: tone-from-the-top program
Pain Points / Risks: - **Awareness-gap risk**: Front-line staff unaware of the channel/protection; mitigated by visible promotion at store level
- **Culture risk**: Leadership tone doesn't support speaking up; mitigated by tone-from-the-top program
System Touchpoints: - HR/L&D (links to VS-19.4/VS-103); communications (links to VS-14.3/VS-103.2); store ops (links to VS-07); legal (links to VS-100.3); ABC training (links to VS-86.3); culture measurement (links to W3731)

steps.activity: Ethics & Compliance Officer/HR-L&D deliver ethics awareness and training: Code of Conduct training at onboarding and annually, role-based training (cash-handling, procurement, B2G sales, AP for ABC risk), scenario-based learning, and the speak-up channel how-to (how/where to report, protection guarantees)
steps.r: Ethics & Compliance Officer / HR-L&D / Store Ops

steps.activity: Ethics & Compliance Officer/Communications run the culture and awareness program: leadership tone-from-the-top messaging, visible channel promotion (posters at 200 stores/DCs, digital channels), and integrity storytelling; measure awareness and trust (links to W3731)

Ethics & Compliance Officer manage training attestation/completion (links to VS-19.4), track awareness KPIs, and refresh content from case learning (W3728) and policy change (W3714); report to governance (links to W3719/VS-36)

fields.Owner: Ethics & Compliance Officer / Ethics Committee Chair
fields.Participants: Ethics Committee (CFO/COO/CHRO/VP Legal & Compliance/Independent), Ethics & Compliance Officer, Board Audit Committee (links to VS-36), Audit (links to VS-21), Risk (links to VS-21.2)
fields.Trigger: Governance cycle; high-severity case; quarterly review

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-review of "review high-severity/substantiated cases, approve major disciplinary/corrective…" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-report of "Ethics & Compliance Officer provide the committee program reporting" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-post of "posture, material cases, and ethics-risk exposure to the Board Audit & Risk…" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: board mandate and independent membership; operational: escalation protocol
Pain Points / Risks: - **Committee-ineffectiveness risk**: Committee lacks authority/independence to act on senior misconduct; mitigated by board mandate and independent membership
- **Reporting-delay risk**: Material cases not escalated to the board timely; mitigated by escalation protocol
System Touchpoints: - Governance/board (links to VS-36); audit/risk (links to VS-21.2); case-management (links to W3720); analytics (links to W3729); disciplinary action (links to W3724)

steps.activity: Ethics & Compliance Officer convene the Ethics Committee (cross-functional executive body) to oversee the program: review high-severity/substantiated cases, approve major disciplinary/corrective action (links to W3724), adjudicate conflicts/escalations, and oversee retaliation response (links to W3725)

Ethics & Compliance Officer provide the committee program reporting: report volume/intake (W3715), triage/investigation status, substantiation rate, case cycle-time, retaliation incidents, and program KPIs (links to W3729); the committee directs priorities and resources

Ethics Committee report program posture, material cases, and ethics-risk exposure to the Board Audit & Risk Committee (links to VS-36/VS-21.2) and ensure the program's independence, resourcing, and authority are sustained
steps.r: Ethics Committee Chair / Ethics & Compliance Officer

fields.Participants: Ethics & Compliance Officer, IT (links to VS-27/VS-99), Procurement (links to VS-34), Legal (links to VS-100.3), Records (links to VS-88), Data Privacy (links to VS-91), Audit (links to VS-21)
fields.Trigger: Vendor selection/management; case lifecycle; records need

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "records, access controls/need-to-know, audit trail, evidence repository,…" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System continuous audit of "Ethics & Compliance Officer/Records manage case records retention and" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-586 (ensure controlled execution — Ethics Governance, Speak-Up Channel & Intake Operations (PA-119.1).)
- operational: due diligence and contract; operational: data-residency requirement
Pain Points / Risks: - **Vendor-confidentiality risk**: Hotline vendor leaks reporter identity; mitigated by due diligence and contract
- **Data-residency risk**: Case data hosted offshore breaches RA 10173; mitigated by data-residency requirement
System Touchpoints: - IT/security (links to VS-27.3); IT asset/SaaS (links to VS-99); procurement (links to VS-34); legal (links to VS-100.3); records (links to VS-88); data privacy (links to VS-91); audit (links to VS-21)

steps.activity: Ethics & Compliance Officer/Procurement select and manage the third-party speak-up hotline/intake vendor and the internal case-management platform: due diligence (security, data-privacy, confidentiality, Philippine data-residency per RA 10173), SLA, and contract (links to VS-34/VS-91)

Ethics & Compliance Officer/IT operate the case-management platform: secure case records, access controls/need-to-know, audit trail, evidence repository, workflow (intake→triage→investigation→closure), and integration to HR/LP/Legal systems where appropriate

Ethics & Compliance Officer/Records manage case records retention and legal-hold (links to VS-88.2), support e-discovery and audit (links to VS-21/VS-88.3), and ensure secure disposition per retention and data-privacy rules (links to VS-91)
